claim_boundary: Declared Anholt-structured proxy only; not the original Anholt boundary, wind data, candidate set, actual layout, evaluator, or reported result.

boundary.coordinate_system: local Cartesian meters; no geospatial or actual Anholt identity

turbine.power_curve: declared cubic in speed cubed from cut-in to rated, rated plateau through cut-out, zero outside

wake.multiple_wake_superposition: root sum square of fixed-source-order fractional deficits

poisson_sampling.annulus: [d,2d] with radius sampled uniformly as stated by Algorithm 1
poisson_sampling.termination: stop when 180 candidates are accepted; declared cardinality completion for the paper's approximately 180 statement

wind_coordinate_convention: flow_to_degrees is Cartesian counterclockwise from positive x
objective: maximize annual energy production in kWh, defined as 8760 times the joint-probability-weighted total turbine power

actual_layout_comparison.reason: The paper plots but does not publish the actual-layout coordinates, full original wind tuples, or curves needed for replay.
actual_layout_comparison.permitted_output: status and reason only; no actual-layout AEP or percentage improvement
